name: Search Project Notebook Knowledge
query: Search my AI Research project for humanoid robotics
context: The authenticated user has access to an project named 'AI Research'. The exact project_id is not provided. The project contains notebooks including 'Humanoid Robotics.md', 'Robotics Simulation.md', and 'AI Research Notes.md'. The user wants to find relevant information but does not ask to modify any notebook.
expected_behavior: Recognizes this as a read-only project search request
Uses get_projects to identify the AI Research project when project_id is unknown
Uses the actual project_id returned by get_projects
Uses search_project to search the project
Uses a meaningful query such as 'humanoid robotics'
Does not provide user_id to the MCP tool
Does not call create_notebook, update_notebook, or delete_notebook
Presents the returned notebook results in ranked order
Does not expose internal authentication information
success_criteria: The correct AI Research project is selected
search_project is used with the actual project_id
The search query preserves the important concepts from the user's request
Relevant notebook results are returned from the MCP response
No project or notebook data is modified
The model does not invent project or notebook IDs
The model does not claim that information exists unless supported by search results
